summary: QIAGEN N.V. filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 (a US-equivalent current report on Form 8-K for a foreign private issuer) reporting the appointment of Jonathan M. Pratt as CEO effective September 1, 2026, succeeding Thierry Bernard, who stepped down from the Managing Board the same day. The appointment follows a comprehensive search, and Pratt will be proposed for shareholder approval as a Managing Director at an Extraordinary General Meeting planned for Q4 2026. QIAGEN reaffirmed its Q3 and full-year 2026 outlook, and noted a strategic review continues. Watch for the EGM approval and any strategic-review outcome.
